{{Top|leg}}
A '''network leader''' was a member of a [[cell network]] run by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]],<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref>

Reporting directly to the [[Case officer/Legends|case officer]], the network leader was the highest-ranking native Intelligence operative on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Responsible for the day-to-day operation of the cell, the network leader was at a degree of risk of detection, but the position on planet allowed the network leader to respond to acquired information faster than the case officer could. Network leaders communicated with the [[area coordinator]]s, but could only communicate with the case officer via blind communication methods to protect the location of [[Sector Headquarters]].<ref name="RASB" />

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naren Bluuis]] served as network leader in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].<ref name="Counterstrike" />
